brief.symptom: combat.user_info TypeError on an NPC target (final run d87ce9a05 x14): an expiring effect sent UserInfo of a debuffed NPC to the caster; a character got its UserInfo twice
brief.owner: EffectTicker refresh (the receiver of a character's UserInfo after an effect change)

cause.explanation: EffectTicker.refreshStats sent UserInfo to the target's session or else the caster's, so an NPC target built UserInfo and threw (fetchPaperdollId), and refreshEffects sent it again for a character
evidence: test_effect_ticker at 12962fed3: TypeError fetchPaperdollId at EffectTicker.js:363 via Timeout; 'no expiry fails to send UserInfo' 1 vs 0; 'the character gets its UserInfo once' 2 vs 1

acceptance: no combat.user_info failure on an NPC effect expiry
a character gets its UserInfo once per effect change, to its own client
